sn50.55-66:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave Gaṅga nadī pācīnaninnā -evam eva bhikkhave bhikkhu- -hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro || || Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu- -hoti nibbānapoṇo -pabbhāro || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddhābalam bhāveti rāgavinaya- dosavinaya- mohavinayapariyosānaṃ || evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcabalāni bhāvento pañcabalāni bhāvento- -bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro ti || || [Uddānam] Cha pācīnato
sn50.55-66:2.0: ninnā samuddato dve ca Gaṅgā dasā honti vaggo tena pavuccati
